brief:
Israeli occupation authorities are continuing to detain the bodies of brothers Ahmad and Khalil al-Aour, according to Maan Wire. The two men are identified as martyrs, though the circumstances of their deaths remain unclear from available reports. The withholding of their remains has not been publicly explained by the authorities.

The detention of Palestinian bodies by Israeli authorities has long been a flashpoint in the conflict, with families often left without answers about when remains will be returned for burial. Rights groups have documented the practice as part of broader restrictions Palestinians face in occupied territories.
title: Israeli authorities hold bodies of two slain brothers.
